spans.s: Ere,Ⓒprep., adv.ⒹpUrvaM, prAk, (with abl.); ‘e(re) this’ ataH pUrvaM; ‘e(re) long’ acirAt-reRa; ‘e(re) now’ nAticiraM, nAticirAtprAk; ‘e(re) while’ kiMcitpUrvaM; See Before.
